item.title: Ikusei
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Msize
  • 発売日: 2022-12-27
  • スコア: 6.92/10 (138 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 育精
  • 英語名: Ikusei

あらすじ

The protagonist, in the midst of puberty, is troubled by the immoral desires that burn in his chest. What exactly does he want?

Through contact with his mother, Mitsue, and his childhood friend, Miki, he gradually becomes aware of his true, repressed desires.

The protagonist, Mitsue, and Miki. When the door hidden in each of their hearts opens, the world that was ordinary will be rewritten in lewd colors.

あらすじ

In a twist of fate, the protagonist comes into possession of a brand-new house.

Once a broke part-timer, he suddenly finds himself living a life of leisure he could’ve never imagined. But his life takes an even more unexpected turn when he meets Urushibara Chieko, his housekeeper…

This M-themed adventure pits you against a cast of beautiful, unique women—tall, mature beauties, devout saints, innocent girls, and otaku loners—who will drain you of everything you hold dear.

  • 英語名: Chou Shiritsu! Onna no Ko-sama Gakuen

别名

  • Super Private Girls Academy!

あらすじ

The main character is a painfully average boy with high school graduation looming before his very eyes.

Unsure of what to do next in his life, and he wanders his way through his precious few remaining school days. But then one day…

He runs into a girl, a former classmate who transferred schools 2 years ago. Her name is Minahara Rinko – and she was his very first love, a love that only existed in his mind, never to come to fruition in reality.
